sentences.text:
And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Neeraj Sahu,Syed Ahmad Abbas Zaidi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
Learned Aga informs that he has procured complete instructions in the matter including upto date
case diary.
Heard Shri Neeraj Sahu, learned counsel for the applicant as well learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present anticipatory bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Surendra @
Surendra Kumar Pal in case Crime No. 03 of 2023, under Sections 376-D, 506 IPC, Police Station Aasiwan, District Unnao, with the prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail as he is apprehending arrest in the above-mentioned case.

Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

Learned counsel for the applicant has given much emphasis on the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. where in she has not imputed any allegation of rape and it is submitted that the allegation of rape has been levelled against the co-accused Sujeet.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the applicant is not having any criminal history and he is ready to cooperate in the investigation.

Learned AGA on the other hand submits that FIR of this case has been lodged by the victim herself,
wherein specific allegation of rape has been levelled against the applicant in the F.I.R. as well as in the statement of victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and in the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she has also imputed the role of abducting/ kidnapping her to the applicant.
Thus, keeping in view the allegations levelled against the applicant, he is not entitled for any protection.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, there cannot be any doubt in the proposition that the facility of anticipatory bail may be accorded to the accused persons of crime which prima facie appears to be fractious/ malicious or as a result of vengeance.
The specific role of committing sexual assault has been levelled against the applicant in the F.I.R. which has been lodged by none other than the prosecutrix herself.

In the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. the applicant has also been assigned the role of dragging, however, the role of commission of rape has been assigned to co-accused Sujeet.

In the considered opinion of this Court it is not a fit case where the discretion may be in favour of the applicant, thus the instant anticipatory bail application moved by the applicant is hereby rejected.
Thus, the prayer of the applicant to release him on anticipatory bail during the course of investigation/ trial is hereby refused.

It appears to be an admitted case to the State that still no warrant etc. has been issued against the applicant and he has not been declared as a proclaimed offender and it is requested on behalf of the applicant that he is ready to appear/ surrender before the trial court for the purpose of procuring regular bail and for this purpose protection for a limited period may be granted to him.

Keeping in view all the facts and circumstances of the case and having regard to the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in Nathu Singh Vs. State of U.P. and others: (2021) 6 SCC 64, to facilitate the surrender of applicant before the trial court for the purpose of procuring regular bail, it is provided that till 5.5.2023 or till surrender/ appearance of the applicant before the trial court for the purpose of securing regular bail, which ever is earlier, the applicant in the event of arrest by the Investigating Officer/ S.H.O. of the police Station concerned in the above case, shall be released on anticipatory bail subject to the following condition:-
(1) The applicant shall appear/surrender before the trial court on or before 5.5.2023,
if he fails to appear/surrender before the trial court, he would not be in a position to take any benefit of this order and in that scenario the Investigating Officer may proceed with investigation of the case, strictly in accordance with law and may take all steps necessary for investigation including the arrest of the applicant if required.
